fees.title: General Information 2027 (PDF) | HKU Undergraduate Admissions
quotes: The composition fees for students admitted in the 2027–2028 academic year will depend on their eligibility for government-subsidised student places.
Students who do not meet the eligibility criteria for subsidised fees, including non-local students, will be required to pay the applicable non-subsidised composition fee, as set out below:

STEM Faculties and Schools — including the Faculties of Engineering, Medicine (excluding the MBBS programme) and Science, and the Schools of Biomedical Engineering, Computing and Data Science*, and Innovation: HK$280,000 per annum, inclusive of the STEM fee*.

Non-STEM Faculties and Schools — including the Faculties of Architecture, Arts, Business and Economics, Education, Law and Social Sciences, and the Schools of Future Media and Governance and Policy: HK$250,000 per annum.

costs.note: Non-local students admitted in 2027-2028 pay the non-subsidised composition fee: HK$280,000 per annum (STEM faculties/schools).
